summary: Frontend-only responsive regression at 390x844, 820x1180 and 1920x1080 using Playwright. RESOLVED from iteration 111: (1) /staff now uses the shared PortalShellE: a fixed dark 260px sidebar on desktop, and below 1100px an off-canvas drawer with exactly one hamburger (portal-nav-toggle) and a working scrim. Choosing a nav item changes the content and closes the drawer. Sign-out is only reachable through staff-avatar -> staff-logout; the duplicate pmc-mobile-signout is gone. No horizontal scroll and no character-wrapped headings. (2) /escrow/me dashboard (escrow-account-dashboard) uses the same shell with all 5 escrow-tab-* items, the bell, the avatar menu (profile / password / sign-out), no legacy w-64 aside, KPI cards stack at 390, the drawer and scrim work, tab switching works and closes the drawer, and the notification dropdown fits at 390 (x=20, w=320). (3) /login at 820 has no horizontal scroll. (4) /tenders/all and /tenders/live at 390 show exactly ONE hamburger (pmc-mobile-menu-open). (5) The /tenders/live filters are populated (sector 26 options, contract 31, country 251, category is a text input) and really filter: KZ shows only KZ cards, IN shows 11, US shows 0, and sector values narrow the list. (6) CTA rows on /, /help and /trust wrap at 390 and nothing is clipped. (7) The help drawer's own box-shadow is now 'none' when closed. (8) All 35 /admin and /admin/e/* routes at 1920 have no horizontal overflow, and the Escrow Institutions bulk bar (notice-account-bulk-*) is aligned. (9) No horizontal page scrollbar (scrollWidth == 390) on any of the 20+ routes tested at 390. NEW or REMAINING problems: an un-closable public mobile menu on phones, missing left gutter on every .pmc-wrap public page at 390, a grey shadow strip still visible on the right edge of public pages at every width (it comes from the mobile-menu drawer, not the help drawer), and a similar shadow leaking at the left edge of the staff and escrow shells on tablet and phone.

minor.issue: SEED DATA: the escrowdemo@pmcmanagers.com escrow_accounts doc had status='approved'. Login only accepts status=='verified' (routers/escrow_accounts.py:348), so the user got 403 'Please verify your email'. Account status and institution status are separate fields. I set the account status back to 'verified' to unblock testing. The linked escrow_institutions doc (6ad035cb319216faed9db030) has status='submitted', not 'approved', so the dashboard shows the 'registration is with PMC's review team' banner.

ui_bugs.issue: Once opened, the menu cannot be closed by touch. (a) The drawer's x button (pmc-mobile-menu-close, at y=20) sits under the sticky .pmc-mobile-topbar (z-index 950 vs drawer 61), so clicks hit the topbar svg. (b) .pmc-mobile-menu-scrim has a computed size of 0x0 (position fixed but no inset/size), so tapping outside does nothing. (c) Tapping the hamburger again only calls setMenuOpen(true). Only the Escape key closes it. Fix: give the drawer and scrim a z-index above the topbar (or start the drawer at top:64px with its own close button visible), set the scrim to inset:0, and make the hamburger toggle.

Content sits flush against the left edge (x=0, padding 0) with an empty 20px gutter on the right. Root cause: index.css:1097 `[data-ui=e] .pmc-wrap{max-width:calc(100% - 20px)!important;padding:0!important}` comes after and overrides mobile-fix.css:41-46 (padding:0 20px; margin:0). With margin:0 the box is left-aligned. Remove the index.css:1097 rule, or change it to `margin:0 auto; padding:0 16px`.

ui_bugs.component: Residual grey strip on the right edge (all public pages, at 390, 820 and 1920)
ui_bugs.issue: This is still visible after the help drawer fix. The source is the always-rendered, closed #pmc-mobile-menu-drawer (translateX(100%), left=innerWidth) with box-shadow -16px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35) from mobile-fix.css:978. The shadow bleeds into the viewport. It is not hidden at desktop either. Only apply the shadow under body.pmc-mob-menu-open, and hide the drawer above the mobile breakpoint.

A faint grey gradient shows along the left edge. The closed .pmc-side keeps box-shadow var(--shadow-pop) (0 16px 40px) from pmc-responsive.css:113 while it is translated to -280px, so the blur leaks in. Move the shadow to the .pmc-adm--navopen .pmc-side and html.pmc-nav-open .pmc-side rules.

The legal sub-nav list (Privacy notice / Terms / ... / Accessibility) overlaps the 'LEGAL' eyebrow and the H1 'Privacy notice'. The last nav link is drawn on top of the eyebrow text, and the content is also flush-left.

Nothing is clipped, but the widths don't match. The form box is 458-772 (314px) and the role cards respect it, while the email/password inputs, Continue and Register buttons are 354px wide (458-812). They overflow the form by 40px and end 8px from the viewport edge. Some tablet CSS rule forces a 354px width; constrain the inputs to width:100% of the form.

issues: The breadcrumb ('Staff / Overview', 'Escrow / Overview') is hidden, so the top bar shows only the hamburger and avatar. The Staff overview tab has no heading, so the user has no page title on mobile.
The mobile row-cards show TEST-BID-V54A, then empty lines for the blank notice and amount cells, then 'PMC · · Us ·'. The cards have no field labels and show empty gaps when values are missing.
The pmc-help-fab is hidden on phones (mobile-fix.css:66), so there is no Help drawer on mobile, only the menu link 'Help & FAQs'. Confirm this is intended.
The top bar has a 'Help' button and the floating Help FAB is also shown: two Help entry points on the same screen.
The CTA 'Register as supplier', the top-bar 'Sign in' and 'Download security overview' use href='#', so they are dead links.

action_items: HIGH: Make the public mobile menu closable by touch. Raise the drawer and scrim z-index above .pmc-mobile-topbar (950), or offset the drawer below the topbar. Give .pmc-mobile-menu-scrim inset:0 (it is currently 0x0). Make the pmc-mobile-menu-open button toggle.
HIGH: Remove or fix index.css:1097 (.pmc-wrap max-width calc(100% - 20px); padding 0). It overrides mobile-fix.css and leaves every public page flush-left at 390.

MEDIUM: Only apply box-shadow to #pmc-mobile-menu-drawer when body.pmc-mob-menu-open is set (mobile-fix.css:978), and hide the drawer on desktop. This is the remaining 'grey strip' on the right edge at every width.
MEDIUM: Fix the /privacy legal sub-nav overlapping the eyebrow and H1 at 390.
MEDIUM: SignInE at 820: inputs and buttons (354px) are wider than the form (314px); constrain them to 100% of the form.
LOW: pmc-responsive.css:113: move the .pmc-side box-shadow to the open state only (left-edge shadow leak on /staff and /escrow/me on tablet and phone).
LOW: Show the page title or breadcrumb in the PortalShellE top bar below 1100px. Add labels or hide empty cells in the escrow transaction mobile cards.

DATA: Keep escrowdemo@pmcmanagers.com escrow_accounts.status='verified' (I corrected it from 'approved'). To test a truly approved institution, set escrow_institutions.status='approved' on institution 6ad035cb319216faed9db030.
critical_code_review_comments: Three CSS files (index.css, mobile-fix.css, pmc-responsive.css) plus pmc-theme-e.css define conflicting !important rules for .pmc-wrap, .pmc-side and drawers, and the last one loaded wins. This caused the .pmc-wrap gutter regression. Consolidate the breakpoint overrides into one file.

PmcMobileNav renders the drawer and scrim on every route at every width and relies on transform alone to hide them. Render them only when the menu is open, or hide them with display:none above the breakpoint.
StaffLogin: filling fields before React hydrates (about 2s) loses the values. A minor test-timing note, not a user issue.

rca of the issue: Grey strip: the closed mobile-menu drawer keeps a 40px-blur box-shadow at left=innerWidth (mobile-fix.css:978), and the closed .pmc-side keeps var(--shadow-pop) at -280px (pmc-responsive.css:113). Flush-left content: index.css:1097 is loaded after mobile-fix.css and overrides the 20px padding. Un-closable menu: scrim is 0x0, the close button is under the z-950 topbar, and the hamburger only opens.
